Key highlights
  • OD1 cut the 38" conductor pipe and installed the protection structure, and was released to new well BOUM-0001. The rig is on standby and waits for BOUM-0001 location clearance.
  • Overstay crew fell from 13 to 10. HLB cleared both of its overstay crew. COSL still holds 10 and needs follow up.
  • OD1 personnel onboard fell from 82 to 75. 53 of the 75 hold a seaman or business visa.
  • OPH stayed off-hired for a second week, and demobilisation continued. CA1 discharged 21 lifts at OPH across Tue 01 and Wed 02 Sep.
  • Vessel trips held at 9, but the mix changed. CA1 fell from 4 trips to 2. CA3 and CA5 each ran 1 trip after most of the week on station. Charlie-3 again ran all 5 crew change circuits.
  • Ground transport peaked on Mon 31 Aug with 8 dispatches, of which six trucks carried empty mud skips to HETCO Mina Abdallah Yard.
  • Cut casing joints of 18-5/8", 13-5/8", 10-3/4" and 7-5/8" went to the KOC scrap yard on Sun 30 Aug. The SWT burner boom sections A, B and C moved to TSS-WT Hall Mina Abdallah on Wed 02 Sep.
  • The port ran day shift only on all eight days. No night shift operation is recorded.
  • Vessel movements remain under MARSEC Level 2.
Data notes, for confirmation before circulation
  • Reporting window is 8 days (26 Aug to 02 Sep). The previous report covered 6 days (20 to 25 Aug). Absolute counts are therefore not like for like. Per day rates are given beside each total.
  • Port sheet cell C4 reads 26.08.2025. The year should be 2026.
  • Port sheet rows 9 to 12 (Thursday 27.08.2026) carry no Day, Date or Status value.
  • Port sheet Status reads Not Normal on all 8 days. Vessel sheet Status reads Normal on all 8 days. The only recurring port exception recorded is no night shift operation.
  • Vessel sheet, Mon 31.08: Charlie-3 embarked 20 Pax and disembarked 20 Pax at OPH. The email reports OPH personnel onboard as Nil. Confirm which is correct.
  • The previous report recorded fuel as bunkered and drill water as delivered to OD1. This week the workbook records fuel as delivered to rigs and drill water as bunkered. Those two categories are not like for like across the weeks.
  • Vessel sheet day names read Wedeneday (26.08) and Thurseday (27.08).
Trip, truck and bulk figures are consolidated from the daily port and vessel logs. One trip is one outbound voyage from Shuaiba Port plus its return. A truck move counts one truck unit per dispatch or arrival. Refer to the attached workbook for line item detail.
